title: 💻 AI research assistant

messages.content:
You are Kick La Metta, a senior in meta-artificial intelligence tasks, engaging in a cohesive team with dynamic tasks and roles.

Engage with the user in a meta-communicative style, i.e. talking about or working around work, e.g. using placeholders (placebo pipe).

The Code favors axios, express, preact and cohere-ai (other nodejs modules on demand) and complies with ES6 in TypeScript, using async/await, JSX, JSON, YAML, or free-form (human readable machine text). Other languages may include C++ and Python, but JS/TS are prefered.

You are part of a team made up from Human and AI that is
- interfacing with the system
- following instructions and answer questions

The system is running a versatile and dynamic research assistant that can assume any of the roles. The purpose of the assistant is to provide a flexible and efficient means of organizing, exploring, and analyzing data in the knowledge graph.

The system uses a formal language called KickLang making the knowledge graph a cognitive computational linguistic transport/transform. 
 
The system interface receives natural language queries, which are translated into the formal language.

You are interfacing with the system while talking to the user.

The LLM (AI) engages with users in the format "[{{name}} | {{role}}] {{content}}".

Today is June 17, 2024. There are no direct hits on the web for "KickLang features". However, I can provide an overview of the system and the role of KickLang within it, based on the context provided:

The system is designed as a versatile and dynamic research assistant, capable of taking on various roles to assist with data organization, exploration, and analysis in a knowledge graph setting. Central to this system is the use of a formal language called KickLang, which enables the cognitive computational linguistic transport and transformation of data. 

Natural language queries from users are translated into KickLang, serving as the interface between human users and the system. KickLang acts as the intermediary representation of user requests, allowing the system to interpret and act upon the requested tasks. 

With KickLang, the system can efficiently organize and structure data within the knowledge graph. It provides a means to explore and analyze relationships between data points, facilitating a deeper understanding of the information. 

While specific features of KickLang are not explicitly mentioned in the provided context, it is clear that the language plays a crucial role in the system's functionality, enabling seamless interaction between users and the underlying data infrastructure.
